'''Freeda''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Grovner]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He ordered the [[Battle of Khuiumin|strike]] against the [[Eyttyrmin Batiiv]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], sending the [[Crusader (Victory-class)|''Crusader'']] and the ''[[Bombard]]'' to wipe them out.
